## Biomechanics Evidence and Measurement Bridge {#sec-biomechanics-evidence-bridge}

A model quantity is not promoted to a biological observation merely because a sensor or inverse problem could be associated with it. The registered bridge separates calibrated primary observables, derived model-dependent quantities, structural non-identifiability, practical qualification gaps, and unavailable measurements. The current human validation state is **externally blocked**.

The complete generated reviewer surface is [`BIOMECHANICS_EVIDENCE_BRIDGE.md`](../BIOMECHANICS_EVIDENCE_BRIDGE.md); the underlying authorities are [`biomechanics_evidence_bridge.json`](../data/biomechanics_evidence_bridge.json) and [`biomechanics_source_register.json`](../data/biomechanics_source_register.json).

### Measurement Validity Boundary

#### Optical Motion Capture {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `optical_motion_capture`. **Source status:** registered. **Directly observed:** calibrated marker image-derived positions; rigid-cluster pose estimates under the declared reconstruction. **Not identifiable:** individual hand forces or moments; muscle force or activation; causal energy-transfer strategy. **Processing authority:** Retain raw trajectories; preregister gap filling, rigid-body reconstruction, coordinate construction, filtering, differentiation, event detection, and all sensitivity variants. **Data gate:** A governed participant-separated motion dataset must retain raw trajectories, calibration, event definitions, missing-data flags, and synchronized sensor timestamps.

#### Force Plates {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `force_plates`. **Source status:** registered. **Directly observed:** calibrated plate reaction wrench; plate-level impulse under the declared integration window. **Not identifiable:** individual hand wrench allocation; muscle coordination; club energy transfer from force magnitude alone. **Processing authority:** Retain raw channels; preregister zero correction, calibration matrix, filtering, wrench transport, center-of-pressure calculation, impulse integration, and whole-system closure. **Data gate:** A governed participant-held-out dataset must provide synchronized raw plate channels, plate geometry, transforms, calibration records, and whole-system Newton-Euler closure variables.

#### Bilateral Six-Axis Grip Wrenches {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `bilateral_six_axis_grip_wrenches`. **Source status:** gap. **Directly observed:** calibrated sensor-frame wrench channels; measured bilateral common and differential modes after declared transforms. **Not identifiable:** muscle or scapular source of a measured wrench; distributed pressure from a lumped wrench; intended control strategy. **Processing authority:** Retain raw bridges and calibration matrices; preregister zero correction, cross-talk correction, frame transport, contact-center model, common/differential decomposition, power, impulse, and work. **Data gate:** No qualifying governed golf dataset with synchronized participant-level bilateral six-axis grip wrenches has been located. Acquisition, calibration, governance, and participant-held-out qualification are required before human allocation claims.

#### Surface EMG {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `surface_emg`. **Source status:** gap. **Directly observed:** electrode voltage history; declared processed activation proxy. **Not identifiable:** individual muscle force; joint or hand torque allocation; passive tissue force. **Processing authority:** Retain raw voltage; preregister artifact rejection, band-pass and notch filtering, rectification, envelope construction, normalization, onset detection, and electromechanical-delay sensitivity. **Data gate:** A source-qualified, governed golf dataset with synchronized raw EMG, placement records, normalization trials, bilateral mechanics, and participant holdout is required.

#### Ultrasound {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `ultrasound`. **Source status:** gap. **Directly observed:** registered image intensity; declared image-derived tissue landmarks. **Not identifiable:** muscle force without constitutive assumptions; whole-muscle stiffness from one imaging plane; neural control strategy. **Processing authority:** Retain source images and probe poses; preregister segmentation, fascicle or junction tracking, anatomical registration, smoothing, and any constitutive conversion. **Data gate:** A source-qualified dynamic golf acquisition must demonstrate tracked probe registration, sufficient sampling, synchronized mechanics, repeatability, and participant-held-out processing.

#### Shaft Strain Inertial Sensing {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `shaft_strain_inertial_sensing`. **Source status:** gap. **Directly observed:** calibrated strain-channel voltage; calibrated inertial sensor channels. **Not identifiable:** distributed shaft state beyond the qualified sensor model; hand allocation from net shaft load; unmeasured damping and boundary conditions. **Processing authority:** Retain raw strain and inertial channels; preregister temperature and zero correction, calibration transform, rigid-motion subtraction, modal or load inversion, filtering, and work-energy reconstruction. **Data gate:** A source-qualified instrumented-club dataset and calibration artifact must establish bandwidth, load reconstruction, structural-model validity, synchronization, and participant holdout.

#### Launch Monitor {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `launch_monitor`. **Source status:** gap. **Directly observed:** device-reported qualified primary metrics; shot-level measurement availability and quality flags. **Not identifiable:** mechanism producing a delivery outcome; human control allocation; unreported proprietary derivations. **Processing authority:** Retain primary device outputs and flags; preregister unit conversion, coordinate alignment, environmental correction, shot matching, outlier rules, and exclusion of unverifiable proprietary composites. **Data gate:** A source-qualified validation and governed shot-level dataset must retain device, firmware, setup, raw qualified metrics, uncertainty, synchronization, and participant holdout.

### Observable Discriminators and Countermodels

#### Segment Kinematic Sequence {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `segment_kinematic_sequence`. **Observable discriminator:** A preregistered participant-held-out comparison must show whether peak-order predictions remain stable across coordinate and filtering variants while same-frame joint power, interface power, and segment-energy histories distinguish transfer from coincident sequencing. **Competing explanations:** coordinate and angular-velocity decomposition choice; filtering and event normalization; different task objectives producing similar peak order. **Falsifier:** The proposed ordering or its claimed association fails under preregistered coordinate methods, participant holdout, or compatible energy and power accounting. **Adverse case:** A swing exhibits the same peak order with opposite interface-power direction or a different order with equal or better delivery outcome.

#### Ground Wrench Pathway {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `ground_wrench_pathway`. **Observable discriminator:** Synchronized force plates and whole-body kinematics must distinguish a ground-wrench change that precedes and closes a predicted momentum change from one that merely covaries with size, speed, or a later motion response. **Competing explanations:** ground wrench as a response to rather than cause of motion; common dependence on golfer size and speed; zero-work redirection at stationary ideal contact. **Falsifier:** Transported wrenches fail calibration or Newton-Euler closure, or preregistered held-out associations do not exceed the stated null and uncertainty bounds. **Adverse case:** Higher club delivery occurs with lower impulse or with a different wrench timing after participant and equipment effects are controlled.

#### Bilateral Hand Wrench Allocation {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `bilateral_hand_wrench_allocation`. **Observable discriminator:** Independently calibrated bilateral six-axis wrenches must resolve common and differential modes that produce the same net club wrench and test whether the registered null-space and contact-center predictions survive calibration uncertainty. **Competing explanations:** different common and differential hand modes producing the same net wrench; distributed grip contact represented by lumped sensors; wrist, arm, and scapular actions sharing a task-equivalent wrench. **Falsifier:** An independently calibrated bilateral dataset contradicts the predicted wrench-map rank, null mode, or registered allocation uncertainty. **Adverse case:** Task-equivalent measured allocations reverse the modeled load or robustness ranking without changing net club delivery.

#### Muscle Activation Timing {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `muscle_activation_timing`. **Observable discriminator:** Raw synchronized EMG must improve held-out prediction of measured bilateral wrench or impedance-related response beyond kinematics and timing alone, across electrode, normalization, detector, and electromechanical-delay sensitivities. **Competing explanations:** cross-talk or normalization artifacts; activation producing stiffness rather than net task torque; unmeasured deep-muscle and passive-tissue contributions. **Falsifier:** The claimed activation sequence is not repeatable across placements and detectors or does not predict held-out mechanical observables beyond uncertainty. **Adverse case:** Similar bilateral wrenches arise from materially different EMG patterns, or the same EMG pattern accompanies opposite wrench allocation.

#### Muscle Tendon Force and Stiffness {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `muscle_tendon_force_and_stiffness`. **Observable discriminator:** Synchronized tissue imaging, EMG, motion, and external wrenches must rule out admissible activation and passive-tissue countermodels by closing held-out joint moments and measured fascicle or tendon trajectories within registered uncertainty. **Competing explanations:** muscle redundancy; passive tissue and co-contraction; subject-specific moment arms and tendon compliance. **Falsifier:** No admissible calibrated parameter set closes measured motion and external wrenches, or the claimed force pattern is not robust across feasible activation solutions. **Adverse case:** Different feasible muscle-force solutions reproduce the same joint and hand mechanics while reversing the proposed energetic attribution.

#### Shaft Load Storage Recoil {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `shaft_load_storage_recoil`. **Observable discriminator:** Calibrated strain and inertial histories must be predicted better by the flexible model than by a rigid-shaft countermodel and must show phase-consistent stored and returned energy without violating measured grip, head, or damping power closure. **Competing explanations:** rigid-body motion leaking into inferred deformation; unmodeled grip and head compliance; phase-dependent load redistribution without net delivery gain. **Falsifier:** A calibrated flexible model fails held-out strain and inertial traces or does not outperform a rigid countermodel under preregistered uncertainty and refinement gates. **Adverse case:** Matched-load flexible and rigid cases show opposite speed effects across plausible stiffness, damping, or timing conditions.

#### Launch Outcome {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `launch_outcome`. **Observable discriminator:** A device-qualified held-out comparison must determine whether the proposed internal mechanism improves prediction of delivery and launch beyond impact location, equipment, participant, and device countermodels. **Competing explanations:** impact location and equipment properties; device and firmware differences; multiple control histories producing equivalent delivery. **Falsifier:** The proposed model fails preregistered held-out delivery distributions or its effect is smaller than device, impact, and participant uncertainty. **Adverse case:** A mechanically different strategy produces an equivalent or better qualified delivery outcome with lower load or variability.

#### Passive Late Negative Torque Origin {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `passive_late_negative_torque_origin`. **Observable discriminator:** Synchronized bilateral wrenches, club and body kinematics, shaft loads, and activation context must separate a force-generated couple, an active wrist-braking moment, a compliant recoil contribution, and a motion-dependent interaction term at the same late-downswing events. **Competing explanations:** active negative wrist torque; separated-hand force couple; shaft and grip compliance; motion-dependent interaction and constraint reactions. **Falsifier:** Measured bilateral wrenches, shaft loads, and inverse-dynamics closure reject the registered sign, timing, persistence, or allocation predictions across participant-held-out trials. **Adverse case:** Negative net couple occurs without the predicted differential hand mode, or the predicted differential mode occurs without favorable club-energy transfer.

#### Slack Preload State {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `slack_preload_state`. **Observable discriminator:** A calibrated transmission experiment must distinguish a true dead-zone or contact-state transition from compliant yielding and impedance change using preload, force-displacement hysteresis, reattachment timing, and held-out perturbation response. **Competing explanations:** intentional compliant yielding rather than slack; sensor threshold and contact-model artifacts; co-contraction changing impedance without changing net wrench. **Falsifier:** A calibrated transmission model cannot distinguish the declared states above sensor uncertainty or the predicted preload advantage disappears under held-out perturbations and fatigue. **Adverse case:** A controlled low-preload state improves delivery robustness or load without increasing timing sensitivity, or persistent preload increases adverse load.

### Population, Equipment, and Task Transport

#### Anthropometry {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `anthropometry`. **Current coverage:** bounded_context. **Limitation:** Subject-scaled models and synthetic anthropometric designs test geometry sensitivity but do not estimate a human population distribution or validate segment inertial parameters for this task. **Data gate:** Retain participant stature, mass, segment calibration, grip span, club fit, and anthropometric-model uncertainty; freeze training-only strata and evaluate held-out calibration and mechanism effects.

#### Sex {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `sex`. **Current coverage:** unqualified. **Limitation:** Female and male anthropometric design profiles are engineering inputs, while much of the cited golf evidence uses male samples; no sex-stratified mechanism or allocation result is established. **Data gate:** Recruit and retain sex and relevant anthropometric strata without treating sex as a mechanical surrogate; preregister interaction estimates and suppress unsupported subgroup inference.

#### Age {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `age`. **Current coverage:** bounded_context. **Limitation:** An age-diverse observational speed-handicap sample does not identify how age modifies bilateral allocation, tissue dynamics, fatigue, or the proposed transfer mechanisms. **Data gate:** Retain age continuously, define age-range transport targets prospectively, measure relevant capacity and recovery covariates, and evaluate participant-held-out calibration and interactions.

#### Skill {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `skill`. **Current coverage:** bounded_context. **Limitation:** Skilled and comparison samples support bounded descriptive differences, but gross sequencing and selected associations do not identify a transferable causal strategy. **Data gate:** Define skill independently of the tested outcome, preserve continuous handicap and experience, stratify participant holdout, and test whether mechanisms add prediction beyond baseline delivery and capacity.

#### Injury {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `injury`. **Current coverage:** unqualified. **Limitation:** The model outputs mechanical proxies and explicitly withholds injury and tissue-loading conclusions; no governed injury history or prospective adverse outcome is linked to the transfer results. **Data gate:** Collect governed injury history, symptoms, exposure, clinical constraints, tissue-load uncertainty, and adverse events under an approved protocol; performance cannot stand in for safety.

#### Handedness {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `handedness`. **Current coverage:** unqualified. **Limitation:** Most cited golf samples and the registered sign conventions are right-handed; relabeling lead and trail sides does not establish mirrored anatomy, coordination, or sensor equivalence. **Data gate:** Retain biological side, playing handedness, grip style, and mirrored frame transforms; qualify sensor calibration and predictions separately before pooling or mirroring.

#### Impairment {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `impairment`. **Current coverage:** unqualified. **Limitation:** The articulated and scapular surrogates are not calibrated to impairment, range restriction, pain, neurological status, or compensatory motion. **Data gate:** Define each target impairment clinically, retain range and functional constraints, validate subject-specific geometry and sensor observability, and use a separately governed held-out analysis.

#### Club {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `club`. **Current coverage:** bounded_context. **Limitation:** Driver, iron, rigid, modal, and synthetic shaft cases use non-equivalent equipment and objectives; no universal equipment effect or calibrated shaft benefit is established. **Data gate:** Retain club make, head, shaft, length, mass, inertia, stiffness, damping, grip, ball, impact location, calibration, and participant-club assignment; test held-out equipment strata.

#### Task {.unnumbered}

**Registry ID:** `task`. **Current coverage:** bounded_context. **Limitation:** Maximum speed, carry, accuracy, load, robustness, partial swings, clubs, and impact definitions are distinct tasks; an optimum under one objective cannot be promoted to another. **Data gate:** Preregister shot intent, target, club, outcome vector, constraints, impact definition, acceptable-shot criteria, fatigue state, and multi-objective comparison before estimating a strategy effect.

The source register contains 16 independently authored works across 16 domains. Source coverage does not remove the externally blocked data gates: no located governed dataset supplies the complete synchronized bilateral six-axis hand wrenches, motion, ground, activation, tissue, shaft, and launch signals required to identify the proposed human mechanisms.
